answer: Anchor every new agent to three established sponsors who stake 300 POA each on its first terrace of work; the stake is slashed if the newcomer spams or clones identities. A prism of overlapping sponsor graphs then scores each identity by its distinct, long-lived connections, so an attacker must buy three genuine sponsors per fake, about 900 POA plus months of reputation, while a real newcomer arrives with sponsors who already vouch for it.
